desc: The MPM approaches (a.k.a hMRI) involves the acquisition of highly-similar anatomical images that differ in terms of application of a magnetization transfer RF pulse (MTon or MToff), flip angle and (optionally) echo time and magnitue/phase parts ([Weiskopf et al. 2013](https://doi.org/10.3389/fnins.2013.00095)). See [here](https://owncloud.gwdg.de/index.php/s/iv2TOQwGy4FGDDZ) for suggested MPM acquisition protocols. Exactly one of: .nii.gz or .nii; .ome.zarr must be present.

# neuro/anat/mpm

DRAFT — generated from BIDS v1.11.2 by aimport/tools/draft_datatypes.py; check the brainlife registry for an existing datatype before registering.

Uses BIDS as the datatype: files are named as in BIDS, BIDS datatype `anat`, suffix `MPM`.

Source: BIDS specification v1.11.2, raw data, `anat/*_MPM`.

Exactly one of: .nii.gz or .nii; .ome.zarr must be present (alternative data formats, none is marked required).

The JSON sidecar is required (the schema requires metadata fields in it).
